coupon_list AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT  -- Removes multiple loan contract records
        coupon.business_date,
        coupon.security_identifier,
        coupon.sentry_security_type,
        CASE

    FROM reference_dev.ci_sentry_security_coupon AS coupon

    WHERE schedule_name = 'Debt_Factor'
      AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-11' AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-11' AS DATE)
          BETWEEN CAST(start_date AS DATE) AND CAST(end_date AS DATE)
)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Description:
-- This query grabs data from ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_data_warehouse_staging,
-- joins it to ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference data, and applies some
-- light business rules from the BRD related to deployment_disposition, 
-- probability_of_close, capital_usage_component, and transaction_cash_flow_type.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.0.0 | 2025-04-28 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Initial version of query
-- v1.0.1 | 2025-05-12 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Edited source data columns based on business requirements.
-- v1.0.2 | 2025-05-28 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Added translation from True/False to Y/N for internal_transfer_y_n
-- v1.0.3 | 2025-05-29 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Remove the max timestamp logic and added run_id injection parameter
-- v1.0.4 | 2025-06-04 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Fixed probability_of_close which did not have the correct logic
--   because the BRD was using incorrect wording (opportunities/deals
--   in the data warehouse close, they don't exit)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

SELECT
  --------------------------------------
  -- metadata
  --------------------------------------
  staging.source,
  staging.business_date,
  staging.run_id,
  staging.extract_timestamp,
  staging.extract_timestamp_iso_8601,
  staging.extract_timestamp_time_zone,
  --------------------------------------
  -- identifiers
  --------------------------------------
  staging.account_id,
  reference.scd_id,
  reference.security_identifier,
  reference.issuer_identifier,
  reference.cppib_security_id,
  reference.cppib_entity_id,
  staging.source_data_id,
  reference.sentry_security_id,
  reference.sentry_issuer_id,
  reference.model_portfolio_code,
  reference.deal_id,
  reference.upstream_pipeline_number,
  --------------------------------------
  -- other reference
  --------------------------------------
  reference.security_name,
  reference.strategy,
  reference.sub_strategy,
  reference.project_name,
  reference.investment_name,
  reference.country_of_exposure,
  reference.private_vs_public,
  reference.asset_category,
  reference.seniority,
  reference.risk_rating,
  reference.investment_department_id,
  reference.investment_status,
  reference.investment_lifecycle,
  reference.sector,
  reference.maturity_date AS maturity_date,
  --------------------------------------
  -- other staging
  --------------------------------------
  staging.funding_currency,
  CASE
    WHEN staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm >= 0 THEN 'Deployment'
    ELSE 'Disposition'
  END AS deployment_disposition,
  COALESCE(staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm, 0) * (COALESCE(staging.probability_of_close, 0) / 100.0) AS probability_weighted_investment_amount_local,
  staging.funded_amount,
  staging.quantity_net,
  staging.market_value,
  staging.portfolio_name,
  staging.sentry_security_type,
  staging.price_multiplier,
  staging.quantity_multiplier,
  staging.debt_factor,
  staging.model_portfolio_id,
  --------------------------------------
  -- fixed-values specified in BRD
  --------------------------------------
  CASE
    WHEN TRY_CAST(staging.expected_funding_date AS DATE)
       > TRY_CAST(staging.business_date         AS DATE)
    THEN COALESCE(staging.probability_of_close, 80)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS probability_of_close,
  'Binding' AS binding,
  CASE
    WHEN staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n = 'Y' THEN 'Net Income and Expenses'
    WHEN staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n IS NOT NULL THEN 'Net Purchases and Sales'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS capital_usage_component,
  CASE
    WHEN staging.internal_transfer_y_n = 'Y' THEN 'Internal Transfer'
    WHEN reference.asset_category = 'Aggregate Projection Shell' THEN 'Aggregate Drawdown/Distribution Projection'
    WHEN staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n = 'Y' THEN 'Income Only'
    ELSE 'Investment Funding/Distribution'
  END AS transaction_cash_flow_type,
  'Y' AS send_to_treasury_y_n,
  --------------------------------------
  -- 'expected'-related fields
  --------------------------------------
  staging.expected_funding_date,
  staging.expected_trade_date,
  staging.expected_exit_price,
  staging.expected_exit_probability,
  staging.expected_exit_date,
  staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm,
  --------------------------------------
  -- will be calculated by python code
  --------------------------------------
  null AS unadjusted_exit_projection,
  --------------------------------------
  -- created by and updated by fields
  --------------------------------------
  staging.last_updated_by,
  staging.last_updated_date,
  staging.created_by_user_group,
  staging.created_by,
  staging.date_updated,
  --------------------------------------
  -- source business dates
  --------------------------------------
  staging.business_date AS staging_src_business_date,
  reference.business_date AS reference_src_business_date,
  --------------------------------------
  -- comment and error
  --------------------------------------
  staging.comment,
  staging.error,
  --------------------------------------
  -- null on purpose (from requirements)
  --------------------------------------
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_required,
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_date,
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_amount,
  NULL AS fo_comments,
  NULL AS pec_recusals,
  NULL AS pec_pipeline_y_n,
  NULL AS fx_spot,
  NULL AS full_amt_cad_mm,
  NULL AS ticket_number,
  NULL AS rejected_deals_reason,
  --------------------------------------
  -- investigate these
  --------------------------------------
  -- staging.investment_program
  -- reference.investment_strategy
  -- reference.investment_group
  -- staging.tfm_inv_sub_strategy
  --------------------------------------
  -- dw-specific fields
  --------------------------------------
  CASE 
    WHEN staging.internal_transfer_y_n = 'True' THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS internal_transfer_y_n,
  staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n,
  --------------------------------------
  -- helpful debug information
  --------------------------------------
  'ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_data_warehouse_staging, ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference' AS data_sources_list
  --------------------------------------
FROM
  ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_data_warehouse_staging staging
LEFT JOIN
  ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference reference
ON
  staging.security_identifier = reference.security_identifier
  AND reference.run_id = '781f913e-50b1-4f3d-a411-e2c290729230'
WHERE
  staging.run_id = '781f913e-50b1-4f3d-a411-e2c290729230'

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Description:
-- This query grabs data from ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_data_warehouse_staging,
-- joins it to ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference data, and applies some
-- light business rules from the BRD related to deployment_disposition, 
-- probability_of_close, capital_usage_component, and transaction_cash_flow_type.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.0.0 | 2025-04-28 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Initial version of query
-- v1.0.1 | 2025-05-12 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Edited source data columns based on business requirements.
-- v1.0.2 | 2025-05-28 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Added translation from True/False to Y/N for internal_transfer_y_n
-- v1.0.3 | 2025-05-29 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Remove the max timestamp logic and added run_id injection parameter
-- v1.0.4 | 2025-06-04 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Fixed probability_of_close which did not have the correct logic
--   because the BRD was using incorrect wording (opportunities/deals
--   in the data warehouse close, they don't exit)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

SELECT
  --------------------------------------
  -- metadata
  --------------------------------------
  staging.source,
  staging.business_date,
  staging.run_id,
  staging.extract_timestamp,
  staging.extract_timestamp_iso_8601,
  staging.extract_timestamp_time_zone,
  --------------------------------------
  -- identifiers
  --------------------------------------
  staging.account_id,
  reference.scd_id,
  reference.security_identifier,
  reference.issuer_identifier,
  reference.cppib_security_id,
  reference.cppib_entity_id,
  staging.source_data_id,
  reference.sentry_security_id,
  reference.sentry_issuer_id,
  reference.model_portfolio_code,
  reference.deal_id,
  reference.upstream_pipeline_number,
  --------------------------------------
  -- other reference
  --------------------------------------
  reference.security_name,
  reference.strategy,
  reference.sub_strategy,
  reference.project_name,
  reference.investment_name,
  reference.country_of_exposure,
  reference.private_vs_public,
  reference.asset_category,
  reference.seniority,
  reference.risk_rating,
  reference.investment_department_id,
  reference.investment_status,
  reference.investment_lifecycle,
  reference.sector,
  reference.maturity_date AS maturity_date,
  --------------------------------------
  -- other staging
  --------------------------------------
  staging.funding_currency,
  CASE
    WHEN staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm >= 0 THEN 'Deployment'
    ELSE 'Disposition'
  END AS deployment_disposition,
  COALESCE(staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm, 0) * (COALESCE(staging.probability_of_close, 0) / 100.0) AS probability_weighted_investment_amount_local,
  staging.funded_amount,
  staging.quantity_net,
  staging.market_value,
  staging.portfolio_name,
  staging.sentry_security_type,
  staging.price_multiplier,
  staging.quantity_multiplier,
  staging.debt_factor,
  staging.model_portfolio_id,
  --------------------------------------
  -- fixed-values specified in BRD
  --------------------------------------
  CASE
    WHEN TRY_CAST(staging.expected_funding_date AS DATE)
       > TRY_CAST(staging.business_date         AS DATE)
    THEN COALESCE(staging.probability_of_close, 80)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS probability_of_close,
  'Binding' AS binding,
  CASE
    WHEN staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n = 'Y' THEN 'Net Income and Expenses'
    WHEN staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n IS NOT NULL THEN 'Net Purchases and Sales'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS capital_usage_component,
  CASE
    WHEN staging.internal_transfer_y_n = 'Y' THEN 'Internal Transfer'
    WHEN reference.asset_category = 'Aggregate Projection Shell' THEN 'Aggregate Drawdown/Distribution Projection'
    WHEN staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n = 'Y' THEN 'Income Only'
    ELSE 'Investment Funding/Distribution'
  END AS transaction_cash_flow_type,
  'Y' AS send_to_treasury_y_n,
  --------------------------------------
  -- 'expected'-related fields
  --------------------------------------
  staging.expected_funding_date,
  staging.expected_trade_date,
  staging.expected_exit_price,
  staging.expected_exit_probability,
  staging.expected_exit_date,
  staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm,
  --------------------------------------
  -- will be calculated by python code
  --------------------------------------
  null AS unadjusted_exit_projection,
  --------------------------------------
  -- created by and updated by fields
  --------------------------------------
  staging.last_updated_by,
  staging.last_updated_date,
  staging.created_by_user_group,
  staging.created_by,
  staging.date_updated,
  --------------------------------------
  -- source business dates
  --------------------------------------
  staging.business_date AS staging_src_business_date,
  reference.business_date AS reference_src_business_date,
  --------------------------------------
  -- comment and error
  --------------------------------------
  staging.comment,
  staging.error,
  --------------------------------------
  -- null on purpose (from requirements)
  --------------------------------------
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_required,
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_date,
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_amount,
  NULL AS fo_comments,
  NULL AS pec_recusals,
  NULL AS pec_pipeline_y_n,
  NULL AS fx_spot,
  NULL AS full_amt_cad_mm,
  NULL AS ticket_number,
  NULL AS rejected_deals_reason,
  --------------------------------------
  -- investigate these
  --------------------------------------
  -- staging.investment_program
  -- reference.investment_strategy
  -- reference.investment_group
  -- staging.tfm_inv_sub_strategy
  --------------------------------------
  -- dw-specific fields
  --------------------------------------
  CASE 
    WHEN staging.internal_transfer_y_n = 'True' THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS internal_transfer_y_n,
  staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n,
  --------------------------------------
  -- helpful debug information
  --------------------------------------
  'ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_data_warehouse_staging, ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference' AS data_sources_list
  --------------------------------------
FROM
  ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_data_warehouse_staging staging
LEFT JOIN
  ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference reference
ON
  staging.security_identifier = reference.security_identifier
  AND reference.run_id = '781f913e-50b1-4f3d-a411-e2c290729230'
WHERE
  staging.run_id = '781f913e-50b1-4f3d-a411-e2c290729230'

/* cppi::0e477fb85d79cd654f2ee2a4e5820787ac05c3cb0040f41a1260e0e6d881260a */
SELECT
                DISTINCT *
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    action_id,
                    data_date,
                    REGEXP_EXTRACT(extended_fields, '(CA_MA_DEAL_TYPE\|)([^\|]*)', 2) AS CA_MA_DEAL_TYPE,
REGEXP_EXTRACT(extended_fields, '(CP_TARGET_TKR\|)([^\|]*)', 2) AS CP_TARGET_TKR,
REGEXP_EXTRACT(extended_fields, '(CA_MA_DEAL_STATUS\|)([^\|]*)', 2) AS CA_MA_DEAL_STATUS,
REGEXP_EXTRACT(extended_fields, '(CA_MA_PCT_SOUGHT\|)([^\|]*)', 2) AS CA_MA_PCT_SOUGHT,
REGEXP_EXTRACT(extended_fields, '(CA_TRANSACTION_TYPE\|)([^\|]*)', 2) AS CA_TRANSACTION_TYPE
                FROM
                    market.bloomberg_corporate_action_equity
            )  AS bloom_ca
            INNER JOIN
                (
                    SELECT
                        action_id,
                        MAX(data_date) AS data_date
                    FROM
                        market.bloomberg_corporate_action_equity
                    WHERE
                        ann_date between DATE('2023-05-26')
                        AND  DATE('2025-05-26')
                        AND mnemonic in ('ACQUIS')
                        AND flag <> 'D'
                    GROUP BY
                        action_id
                ) AS ca_latest
            ON
                bloom_ca.action_id = ca_latest.action_id
                AND bloom_ca.data_date = ca_latest.data_date
            WHERE
                CA_MA_DEAL_STATUS = 'Pending'

                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,

        max(arrival_time) over (partition by rm_id, business_date_adj) as max_publish

        data_date, 
        vendor, 
        currency, 
        exchange_rate, 
        is_exchange_holiday_flag, 
        year_month,
        'CAD' AS base_currency
    FROM 
        market.cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad

    SELECT 
        data_date, 
        vendor, 
        'CAD' AS currency, 
        1 / exchange_rate AS exchange_rate, 
        is_exchange_holiday_flag, 
        year_month,
        currency AS base_currency
    FROM 
        market.cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad
)

UNION ALL

WHERE NOT (currency = 'CAD' AND base_currency = 'CAD')) AS "FX Rates - CAD"

 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 12
		AND hour between 05 and 06
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 05:06:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT
            from_currency as from_currency,
            to_currency as to_currency,
            ROUND(case
                when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price
                else mid_price
                end,6) as mid_price,
            business_date
        FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
        WHERE
            from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD'
            and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
            and business_date = Date('2025-06-12')
        UNION
        Select
            MainTable.to_currency as from_currency,
            'CAD' as to_currency,
            ROUND(case
                when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then
                MainTable.mid_price * CAD_Rate.mid_price
                else (1/MainTable.mid_price) * CAD_Rate.mid_price
                end,6) as calc_mid_price,
            MainTable.business_date
        FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr as MainTable
        Left Join
        (
            SELECT
                case
                when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price
                else mid_price
                end as mid_price,
                business_date
            FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
            WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and business_date = Date('2025-06-12')
            and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
        ) as CAD_Rate on
            MainTable.business_date = CAD_Rate.business_date
        WHERE
            MainTable.business_date = Date('2025-06-12')
            and MainTable.from_currency = 'USD'
            and MainTable.mid_price != 0
            and MainTable.source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
            order by business_date,from_currency

with risk_hierarchy as (
	select business_date,
		dim_hierarchy_node_id,
		node_level,
		(
			case
				when node_level = 1 then 'CPPIB-ALL'
				when node_level = 2 then 'DEPARTMENT'
				when node_level = 3 then 'STRATEGY'
				when node_level = 4 then 'PROGRAM'
				when node_level = 5 then 'SUB-PROGRAM'
				when node_level = 6 then 'MODEL_PORTFOLIO' else 'UNKNOWN'
			end
		) as hierarchy_level,
		'RISK' as HIERARCHY_TYPE,
		node_name,
		'' as account,
		'' as pool,
		parent_node_id,
		investment_dept,
		investment_strat,
		program,
		sub_program,
		model_portfolio
	from radar_reporting_prod.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_risk
	where business_date = '2025-06-11'
),
classification_secno as (select inst_id, cppib_sector_classification_name_1 as industry_sector_name  
			from cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite class
			join risk_prod.dim_inst i on i.security_number = class.abor_security_number and i.business_date = cast(class.business_date as varchar) 
			where i.business_date = '2025-06-11' and class.esm_instrument_type = 'abor_security_number'
			union
			select inst_id, cppib_sector_classification_name_1 as industry_sector_name  
			from cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite class 
			join risk_prod.dim_inst i on i.cppib_security_id = cast(class.cppib_sec_id as varchar) and i.business_date = cast(class.business_date as varchar) 
			where i.business_date = '2025-06-11' and class.esm_instrument_type = 'cppib_sec_id'
)
select 
	(
		case
			when dpi.portfolio_type in ('IP', 'CASH_FOR_BENEFIT', 'ACPP_CFB') then dpi.pos_source_system_key
			when dpi.portfolio_type = 'INDEX_LOOKTHROUGH' then replace(dpi.pos_source_system_key, 'CPPSECID')
			when dpi.portfolio_type = 'LOOKTHROUGH' and position('OFFSET' in dpi.pos_source_system_key) > 0 then dpi.pos_source_system_key
			else concat(substr(dpi.pos_source_system_key, 1, position('_' in dpi.pos_source_system_key)-1), '_', dpi.pos_short_desc)
		end 
	) as "position_key",
	currency.iso_currency_code "DV01_currency",
	curve.curve_value "DV01_curve",
	curve_type.curve_type_value "DV01_curve_type",
	dv01.data_source "DV01_data_source",
	term.term_value "DV01_tenor",
	coalesce((1 / fx.mid_val), 1) * dv01.final_value "DV01_cad_value",
	dv01.final_value,	
	dv01.initial_value,
	dv01.override_source,
	dv01.override_value,
	dv01.portfolio_type,
	dv01.scaling_type,
	dpi.maturity_date,
	dpi.pos_short_desc as "position_description",
	rh.model_portfolio as "scd_model_portfolio",
	rh.investment_dept,
	rh.investment_strat as "investment_strategy",
	rh.program as "investment_program",
	rh.sub_program as "investment_sub_program",
	dpi.cppib_product_type as "product_type",
	dpi.security_group_name as "product_group",
	(
		case 
			when i_rle.party_name is not null then i_rle.party_name
			when l1_rle.party_name is not null then l1_rle.party_name
			when mi_rle.party_name is not null then mi_rle.party_name
			else null
		end
	) as issuer_party_name,
	(
		case 
			when i_rle.gics_sector is not null then i_rle.gics_sector
			when l1_rle.gics_sector is not null then l1_rle.gics_sector 
			when cl.industry_sector_name is not null then cl.industry_sector_name
			when mi_rle.gics_sector is not null then mi_rle.gics_sector
			else null
		end
	) as issuer_gics_sector,
	cpr.rating_value as "issuer_final_rating",
	csr.rating_value as "inst_final_rating",
	(
		case 
			when dpi.isin is not null then dpi.isin 
			when inst1.isin is not null then inst1.isin
			else inst2.isin
		end
	) as isin,
	(
		case 
			when dpi.sedol is not null then dpi.sedol 
			when inst1.sedol is not null then inst1.sedol
			else inst2.sedol
		end
	) as sedol,
	(
		case 
			when dpi.cusip is not null then dpi.cusip 
			when inst1.cusip is not null then inst1.cusip
			else inst2.cusip
		end
	) as cusip,
	(
		case 
			when i_rle.secm_exposure_country is not null then i_rle.secm_exposure_country
			when l1_rle.secm_exposure_country is not null then l1_rle.secm_exposure_country 
			when mi_rle.secm_exposure_country is not null then mi_rle.secm_exposure_country
			else null
		end
	) as issuer_country_of_exposure
from radar_reporting_prod.fact_pos_calc_md dv01
	join radar_reporting_prod.dim_calc_currency currency ON dv01.dim_calc_currency_id = currency.dim_calc_currency_id
	and dv01.business_date = currency.business_date
	join radar_reporting_prod.dim_calc_term term ON dv01.dim_calc_term_id = term.dim_calc_term_id
	and term.CALC_DIM_TYPE = 'TERM'
	and dv01.business_date = term.business_date
	join radar_reporting_prod.dim_calc_curve curve ON dv01.dim_calc_curve_id = curve.dim_calc_curve_id
	and curve.CALC_DIM_TYPE = 'CURVE'
	and dv01.business_date = curve.business_date
	join radar_reporting_prod.dim_calc_curve_type curve_type ON dv01.dim_calc_curve_type_id = curve_type.dim_calc_curve_type_id
	and curve_type.CALC_DIM_TYPE = 'CURVE_TYPE'
	and dv01.business_date = curve_type.business_date
	join radar_reporting_prod.dim_pos_inst dpi ON dv01.pos_id = dpi.pos_id
	and dv01.business_date = dpi.business_date
	left join radar_reporting_prod.fact_fx_rate fx ON currency.iso_currency_code = fx.to_currency
	and currency.chron_id = fx.chron_id
	and fx.from_currency = 'CAD'
	and fx.rate_type = 'CROSS'
	and dv01.business_date = fx.business_date
	left join RISK_HIERARCHY rh on rh.dim_hierarchy_node_id = dv01.dim_hierarchy_node_id
	left join radar_reporting_prod.dim_inst main_inst on main_inst.inst_id = dpi.inst_id
	left join radar_reporting_prod.dim_inst inst1 on inst1.inst_id = dpi.inst1_id 
	left join radar_reporting_prod.dim_inst inst2 on inst2.inst_id = dpi.inst2_id
	left join classification_secno cl on cl.inst_id = main_inst.inst_id
	left join radar_reporting_prod.ref_legal_entity i_rle on i_rle.legal_entity_id = dpi.issuer_id
	left join radar_reporting_prod.ref_legal_entity cp_rle on cp_rle.legal_entity_id = dpi.counter_party_id
	left join radar_reporting_prod.ref_legal_entity l1_rle on inst1.issuer_id = l1_rle.legal_entity_id
	left join radar_reporting_prod.ref_legal_entity mi_rle on main_inst.issuer_id = mi_rle.legal_entity_id
	left join radar_reporting_prod.cppib_party_rating cpr on cpr.cppib_party_id = i_rle.cppib_party_id 
	and cpr.business_date = i_rle.business_date
	left join radar_reporting_prod.cppib_security_rating csr on csr.cppib_sec_id = cast(dpi.cppib_security_id as int)
	and csr.business_date = i_rle.business_date
where curve_type.curve_type_value = 'ZERO'
	and dv01.calc_type = 'DV01'
	and dv01.business_date = '2025-06-11'
	and dv01.final_value <> 0
union all
select null as "position_key",
	currency.iso_currency_code as "DV01_currency",
	curve.curve_value "DV01_curve",
	curve_type.curve_type_value "DV01_curve_type",
	concat(
		'DV01 MP OVERRIDE -',
		rh.model_portfolio,

	) "DV01_data_source",
	term.term_value "DV01_tenor",
	coalesce((1 / fx.mid_val), 1) * dv01.override_value "DV01_cad_value",
	dv01.final_value,	
	dv01.initial_value,
	dv01.override_source,
	dv01.override_value,

	rh.investment_dept,

	null as "sedol",

	null as "issuer_country_of_exposure"

	join RISK_HIERARCHY rh on dv01.dim_hierarchy_node_id = rh.dim_hierarchy_node_id
	and rh.node_level = 6
	join radar_reporting_prod.dim_calc_currency currency ON dv01.dim_calc_currency_id = currency.dim_calc_currency_id
	and dv01.business_date = currency.business_date
	join radar_reporting_prod.dim_calc_term term ON dv01.dim_calc_term_id = term.dim_calc_term_id
	and dv01.business_date = term.business_date
	join radar_reporting_prod.dim_calc_curve curve ON dv01.dim_calc_curve_id = curve.dim_calc_curve_id
	and dv01.business_date = curve.business_date
	join radar_reporting_prod.dim_calc_curve_type curve_type ON dv01.dim_calc_curve_type_id = curve_type.dim_calc_curve_type_id
	and dv01.business_date = curve_type.business_date
	left join radar_reporting_prod.fact_fx_rate fx ON currency.iso_currency_code = fx.to_currency
	and fx.from_currency = 'CAD'
	and fx.rate_type = 'CROSS'
	and dv01.business_date = fx.business_date
where dv01.business_date = '2025-06-11'

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency

			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency

			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:

			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'

		, case

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd

			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD

			select

				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */

				(

				or (

					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id

				, "level"

				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly

				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'

		on

		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0

				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */

				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (

					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

	/* DATA PULLED:

	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' then 'Base CPP Value-Added'

			, pnl_fytd_rc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fytd_lc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency

			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), cmb as (
	select * from scd_perf
	union all
	select * from perf
), cmb_clean as (
	select
		cmb.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case
			when period = '1D' then '1. 1-Day'
			when period = 'MTD' then '2. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '3. QTD'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '5. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '6. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		cmb
	where
		value is not null
		and business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		and not ( pbor_node_name in ( 'Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' ) and metric_type = 'Return' )
)
select * from cmb_clean) AS "finsights_perf_returns_income_daily"

			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' then 'Base CPP Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD' then 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
			else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, node_name as pbor_node_name
			, "level" as split_level
			, time_weighted_return_rc as time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_lc as time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_rc as pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_lc as pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_qtd_rc as pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fytd_rc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fytd_lc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), cmb as (
	select * from scd_perf
	union all
	select * from perf
), cmb_clean as (
	select
		cmb.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case
			when period = '1D' then '1. 1-Day'
			when period = 'MTD' then '2. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '3. QTD'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '5. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '6. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		cmb
	where
		value is not null
		and business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		and not ( pbor_node_name in ( 'Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' ) and metric_type = 'Return' )
)
select * from cmb_clean) AS "finsights_perf_returns_income_daily"

/* cppi::322a582008bd024f7dd8c8c88508e1aa4f4f398dc6dc872073fc51cf95a05c98 */
with cte as
(
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ISIN ORDER BY (CASE WHEN cppib_sec_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END), cppib_sec_id) AS rn
    FROM asset.asset_bonds
    where business_date = date'2025-06-11'
),
cmb as
(
    select
		id_cppib_security,
		maturity_bucket
	from (
		select distinct
			id_cppib_security,
			maturity_bucket,
			row_number() over (
				partition by id_cppib_security
				order by 
					case when feed_name like 'lbfi_%' then 1 else 2 end,
					cast(
						case
							when position('-' in maturity_bucket) > 1 then substr(maturity_bucket, 1, position('-' in maturity_bucket) - 1)
							else null
						end as integer
					) asc
			) as row_num
		from market.cppib_maturity_bucket
    	where business_date = date'2025-06-11' and maturity_bucket is not null and maturity_bucket != ''
	)
	where row_num = 1
)
select
    ilb.business_date,
    'IR_ILB_Benchmark' as benchmark_name,
    ilb."investment cell" as category,
    null as id_cppib_index,
    'tfm_bp_ilb_benchmark' as feed_name,
    ilb.indexID as index_name,
    cte.instrument_description as security_name,
    'Fixed Income' as asset_type,
    cte.sedol as sedol,
    cte.cusip as cusip,
    cte.isin as isin,
    ms.type,
    ms.sub_type,
    ilb.priceEOP as last_value_eod,
    ilb.priceEOP as last_value_ndo,
    ilb."benchmark weight" as weight_eod,
    ilb."benchmark weight" as weight_ndo,
    p.party_name as issuer_name,
    cte.cppib_sec_id as id_cppib_security,
    cte.currency_code as iso_currency_eod,
    cte.country_code as country_domicile,
    cte.listing_country_code as country_listing,
    cte.region_code as region,
    ms.cppib_market_capitalization_size_code as market_capitalization_size_code,
    cte.country_code as country_reference_code_eod,
    ilb."benchmark weight" as benchmark_constituent_weight,
    null as sub_component,
    sr.rating_value as security_rating,
    pr.rating_value as issuer_rating,
    null as developed_market_flag,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_code_1 as classification_code_1,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_name_1 as classification_code_1_description,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_code_2 as classification_code_2,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_name_2 as classification_code_2_description,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_code_3 as classification_code_3,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_name_3 as classification_code_3_description,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_code_4 as classification_code_4,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_name_4 as classification_code_4_description,
    null as alternate_listing,
    rc.country_name,
    ilb.mrktValue as market_capitalization_base_eod,
    null as investable_shares_eod,
    cte.trade_currency_code as iso_currency_local,
    null as quality,
    cmb.maturity_bucket as maturity_bucket
from market.tfm_bp_ilb_benchmark ilb
left join cte
    on ilb.business_date = cte.business_date and ilb.isin = cte.isin and cte.rn = 1
left join cmb
    on cte.cppib_sec_id = cmb.id_cppib_security
left join asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications ms
    on cte.cppib_sec_id = ms.cppib_sec_id and ilb.business_date = ms.business_date
left join asset.asset_security_ratings sr
    on cte.cppib_sec_id = sr.cppib_sec_id and ilb.business_date = sr.business_date and sr.rating_agency = 'CPPIB'
left join asset.asset_security_party_relationship spr
    on cte.cppib_sec_id = spr.cppib_sec_id and cte.business_date = spr.business_date and spr.role = 'ISSUER'
left join party.party p
    on spr.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id and ilb.business_date = p.business_date
left join party.party_ratings pr
    on spr.cppib_party_id = pr.cppib_party_id and ilb.business_date = pr.business_date and pr.rating_agency = 'CPPIB'
left join reference.reference_country_codes rc 
    on rc.country_code = cte.country_code and ilb.business_date = rc.business_date
where ilb.business_date = date'2025-06-11'

SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion
		and mhl.pool_name not in ( 'ACPP', 'BCPP' )
		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)
group by 
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

			target_status_code AS status,

		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 12
		AND hour between 12 and 13
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 12:33:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

    h.abor_instrument_type as instrument_type_name,
    sec.country_of_exposure_code as exposure_country_code,
    sec.country_of_exposure_name as exposure_country_name,
    sec.currency_of_exposure_code as exposure_currency_code,
    sec.currency_of_exposure_name as exposure_currency_name,
    h.balance_nominal_number as balance_nominal,
    h.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency * h.clean_price as clean_price_pc,
    h.clean_price as clean_price_qc,
    h.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency as balance_cost_value_qc,

    h.balance_book_value_quotation_currency as balance_book_value_qc,
    h.clean_value_quotation_currency as clean_value_qc,
    h.clean_value_portfolio_currency as clean_value_pc
  from holdings.scd_holdings_main h
  join (
  SELECT *,
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
			PARTITION BY abor_security_id
			ORDER BY business_date DESC
		) AS rn
	FROM reference.scd_securities
	WHERE business_date = '2025-06-11'
  ) sec
 on h.scd_security_id = sec.scd_security_key_id
    where h.business_date = '2025-06-11'
    and (
     (h.security_group_id = 'PEDIRECT'   and h.abor_security_type_id = 'PEDIRECT')
  OR (h.security_group_id = 'PESECOND'   and h.abor_security_type_id IN ('PRINCSEC', 'SECFUND'))
  OR (h.security_group_id = 'PI DEBT'   and h.abor_security_type_id = 'IX-DPD OTH')
  OR (h.security_group_id = 'PFPREQUITY' and h.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUND OF FD','LARGEBO', 'LEGACY', 'MDMKTBOEU',

)
) as a
